def relative_primary_matches(controller,command):
    """Resolve only the actual primary Python program, never an argument marker."""
    argv=shlex.split(command)
    if not argv or not Path(argv[0]).name.lower().startswith('python'):return False
    program=None
    for value in argv[1:]:
        if value in ['-c','-m']:return False
        if value.startswith('-'):continue
        program=value;break
    declared=controller.get('script')
    if not program or Path(program).is_absolute() or not program.endswith('.py') or not declared or not Path(declared).is_absolute():return False
    pid=controller['pid']
    actual_executable=subprocess.check_output(['ps','-p',str(pid),'-o','comm='],text=True).strip()
    if not controller.get('executable') or actual_executable!=controller['executable']:return False
    cwd_output=subprocess.check_output(['lsof','-a','-p',str(pid),'-d','cwd','-Fn'],text=True)
    directories=[line[1:] for line in cwd_output.splitlines() if line.startswith('n')]
    if len(directories)!=1 or not Path(directories[0]).is_absolute():return False
    return (Path(directories[0])/program).resolve()==Path(declared).resolve()

def test_relative_primary_requires_actual_cwd_executable_and_exact_program(self):
        controller=self.records[r.OWNER]['controller']
        controller.update(script='/mcr/owned folder/start.py',executable='/actual/python')
        self.rows=[(111,1,1024,"python 'owned folder/start.py'")]
        def metadata(command,**_kwargs):
            return '/actual/python\n' if command[0]=='ps' else 'p111\nn/mcr\n'
        self.comm_response=metadata
        self.assertEqual(self.census()['claims'],1)
        self.comm_response=lambda command,**kwargs:'/wrong/python\n' if command[0]=='ps' else metadata(command,**kwargs)
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(AssertionError,'Controller script/root mismatch'):self.census()
        self.comm_response=lambda command,**kwargs:metadata(command,**kwargs) if command[0]=='ps' else 'p111\nn/wrong\n'
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(AssertionError,'Controller script/root mismatch'):self.census()
        self.comm_response=metadata
        self.rows=[(111,1,1024,"python other.py --output 'owned folder/start.py'")]
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(AssertionError,'Controller script/root mismatch'):self.census()
        self.rows=[(111,1,1024,"python -c 'print(1)' 'owned folder/start.py'")]
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(AssertionError,'Controller script/root mismatch'):self.census()
